title: feat(core): deprecate addWidget & removeWidget
body: Migration guide already mentions this since dc75d2fc64c68876d91e9daf847038607c1215aa, discussed with @samouss

comments.body: We shouldn't recommend using `addWidget()` anymore then. There are still some spots (e.g. [`connectGeoSearch`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/432f833c9bc3100f89bfafa80b4a14e1862b4517/src/connectors/geo-search/connectGeoSearch.js#L123-L127)).

> We shouldn't recommend using `addWidget()` anymore then. There are still some spots (e.g. [`connectGeoSearch`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/432f833c9bc3100f89bfafa80b4a14e1862b4517/src/connectors/geo-search/connectGeoSearch.js#L123-L127)).

We remove most of the warnings from 3.x.x, the one on `geoSeach` should be removed too. We don't have to update them.
